## Elden Ring Nightreign Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia Boss Guide

### Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia Fight Strategy

When the fight begins, all seven Balancers appear at once and quickly scatter across the arena. In this opening phase, the Balancers have very low health and a fairly limited attack pool, mostly simple melee swipes and stabs. Because of this, it's highly recommended to bring a weapon that inflicts [Sleep](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Sleep "Sleep"), such as the [Sword of St Trina](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Sword_of_St_Trina "Sword of St Trina"), or any weapon carrying the "Attacks Inflict Sleep" passive effect. The Sleep status procs quickly and is effective enough to take a Balancer out of the fight long enough for the rest to be cleaned up. The Balancers will stagger from nearly any attack thrown at them, with the exception of when they're performing their special attacks. To move on to the next phase, all seven Balancers need to be killed, which brings the main health bar down to 70%.

Phase 2 kicks in once the health bar reaches that 70% mark. At this point, all of the Balancers get revived, and one of them becomes the leader, easily identified by a large pink scarf. The Balancers then perform a dive attack, where each one dives toward a targeted player, marked by a red dot, leaving behind an exploding trail as it goes. Once every Balancer has finished dashing, they all converge together from around the arena toward the targeted player, and the leader follows up by charging a hail of massive explosive spears that quickly tear through anything in their path.

The leader Balancer also picks up new attacks and longer combos during this phase. Once it's killed, every remaining Balancer is stunned for a short time, giving the group a window to deal some extra damage before a new leader rises to take its place. It's worth noting that the dive attack used during this phase transition happens every single time a new leader emerges, so if that attack is giving trouble, it may help to limit how often the leader is killed. The lesser Balancers in this phase have more health than before, though they can still be brought down, and attacking them still chips away at the overall health bar, so killing each one individually helps make the fight less hectic overall. That said, since the lesser Balancers teleport and dash around quite a bit, hunting them down can end up being a bit tedious or time-consuming.

From time to time, the leader will teleport all of the Balancers at once and gain a stack of up to three attack buffs. Killing off the lesser Balancers is the way to cut down the strength of that buff.

#### Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia Overview

Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia is a humanoid Nightlord with an appearance that resembles a Valkyrie. What sets this encounter apart from other Nightlord fights is that players aren't facing a single enemy directly, but rather several Balancers acting independently, overwhelming the group through simultaneous attacks from multiple directions. Each Balancer has its own individual health bar, separate from the overall health bar belonging to Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia itself, though damaging a Balancer still chips away at the boss's overall HP. In the first phase of the fight, there are seven Balancers in total that need to be defeated. These Balancers rely on basic spear attacks for the most part, occasionally casting a spell that causes numerous spears to erupt from the ground. They're not too difficult to deal with individually, since players can stagger them and interrupt most of their attacks, and a group of players can also focus fire on a single Balancer at a time to speed things up.

Once all seven Balancers have been defeated, bringing Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia's overall health down to around 70%, the Balancers are revived and the second phase begins. At this point, one Balancer stands out with pink wings, marking it as the leader of the group. During this phase, players need to pay close attention to what the lead Balancer is doing, since it's capable of commanding the others to dive toward a single area, or it may instead unleash devastating spear attacks of its own. All of the Balancers also gain access to a new move called Purity of Lightning, a grab attack that deals heavy damage if it manages to connect. Aside from these additions, the core mechanics of the fight stay consistent with the first phase, meaning attacks on any Balancer continue to lower Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia's overall health. If players manage to fully deplete the lead Balancer's health, the rest of the Balancers are momentarily staggered, opening up a safe window to land some counterattacks.

#### Phase 1

At the start of the encounter, players will face seven **Balancers**, each wielding a spear and capable of performing basic thrusting and stabbing attacks. Although these attacks are straightforward and highly telegraphed, players should be cautious not to be piled on by the **Balancers**. Players who allow themselves to be surrounded by many **Balancers** may find their movement restricted, creating unnecessary situations that can render the spear attacks difficult to avoid. Players should maintain proper spacing to prevent the **Balancers** from boxing them out, which is essential for surviving the early parts of the fight.

While the **Balancer's** melee attacks are predictable, several abilities require the attention of the players. One of these attacks is the **Circle of Purification**, an uninterruptible spell that begins with a **Balancer** channeling before releasing a circle of spears that move outward. The safest way to avoid this attack is to sprint away from the caster, then dodge roll toward them as the spears begin to move outward, slipping through the whole attack. Players should also be cautious of the **Purifying Light**, which is the long-range spell that the **Balancers** will use throughout the fight. Although it is slow and telegraphed, it can punish players who are distracted by the other **Balancers**.

For **Phase 1**, the most effective strategy is to lure individual **Balancers** away from the group and punish their recovery animations after successfully dodging their attacks. These **Balancers** can be staggered, allowing players to interrupt them consistently. If playing in a group, players can quickly isolate and overwhelm one **Balancer** at a time. Players should also maximize the opportunity to attack during the **Circle of Purification**, as players can freely hit the **Balancer** if they dodge the initial wave of spears while sticking close to the casting **Balancer**.

#### Phase 2

Once all seven **Balancers** are defeated, they will resurrect simultaneously and initiate **Phase 2**. One of the **Balancers** will stand out from the rest due to its pink wings, serving as the leader that directs the group of **Balancers'** coordinated attacks. Players should keep track of the leader **Balancer**, as it shows the clearest visual cues for predicting the patterns and timings of the group assaults.

In this phase, the **Balancers** retain their standard spear attacks but begin incorporating more dangerous attacks. At the direction of the leader, the **Balancers** may execute a series of diving attacks, either one at a time or all together. These dives leave glowing trails of light that explode shortly after, creating hazardous zones that restrict the players' movement and punish those stubborn enough who do not reposition quickly. Observing the positioning of the head **Balancer** will give players the best chance of anticipating the type of attack. The **Balancers** also gain access to the **Purity of Lightning** attack, an extremely damaging grab indicated by the spark forming on their left hands. When caught by the attack, players are rendered immobile and a **Balancer** will impale the player, dealing devastating damage.

During **Phase 2**, players are recommended to concentrate their attacks on the head **Balancer** when given the chance, as depleting its health will cause the other **Balancers** to be momentarily staggered, granting players a window to attack the other balancers freely. This stagger mechanic allows players to rapidly reduce the number of **Balancers** in **Phase 2**, avoiding being overwhelmed by their numbers.

### Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia Attacks & Counters

#### Purifying Light

A **Weapon-Bequeathed Harmonia** channels a spell while its spear glows, sending out light that travels through the ground, generating spears that emerge from the ground. To evade the attack, players can move or dodge roll sideways to get out of the path of the spell.

#### Circle of Purification

A **Weapon-Bequeathed Harmonia** assumes a lowered stance, channeling a spell that makes spears emerge in a circle around it. As soon asthe spell is channeled, players can sprint out of the circle or time a dodge roll towards the boss as the spears emerge to retaliate as it recovers.

#### Spear Swipe

A **Weapon-Bequeathed Harmonia** teleports, then leaps in the direction of a player, swiping its spear across as it lands. When a **Balancer** leaps at the player, they can dodge roll towards the boss to avoid the swipe. Players may then retaliate by attacking once or twice, depending on their attack speed.

#### Spear Thrust

A **Balancer** holds its spear blade-first, runs at its target, then thrusts its spear forward. Occasionally, a **Balancer** will do two consecutive **Spear Thrusts**. When a **Balancer** holds its spear horizontally, facing forward, players can strafe sideways or dodge roll to the side to avoid the Spear. Players may then circle towards the back of the **Weapon-Bequeathed Harmonia** to punish it as it recovers from the attack.

#### Double Spear Swipe

One of the **Balancers** will wind up its spear on the right, then swipe it across twice. Players can dodge roll towards the **Balancer** to get to its rear to avoid the second swipe and retaliate, or dodge roll away to get out of melee distance.

#### Purity of Lightning (Phase 2)

A **Balancer** raises its left hand as it floats in the air, emitting light, then dives at the player using its lightning-imbued hand. If players are caught by the **Purity of Lightning**, they will be impaled with a large spear that emerges from the ground, then stabbed by a **Balancer**, dealing devastating damage. When the **Balancer** starts to dive at the player, they can dodge roll towards the Balancer to get to its rear and attack it from behind. The **Lightning Dive** can reach players from a significant distance, so players should be cautious even if they maintain a safe distance from the **Balancers**.

#### Harmonious Smite (Phase 2)

The main **Balancer** floats in the sky, then calls on all of the **Balancers** to group up and dive at a target one at a time. The **Balancers** will leave a trail of light that erupts after a short delay, damaging players caught stepping on them during the eruption. After all **Balancers** have dived, all the **Balancers** will then dive at the targeted player's location simultaneously, leaving more explosive trails. The main **Balancer** will then channel a spell that generates Spears raining down from the skies, causing explosions upon impact. Players should surge sprint away from the dashes and quickly get out of the trails' AoE before they explode, and move horizontally from the main **Balancer** to escape the path of the exploding spears. Rays of light will descend from the sky at an angle, indicating the area of effect for the spell. If you cannot escape in time, a dodge roll forwards (into the spears) can work, but is very risky and should be a last resort. Players should try to dodge early, as the spears travel too quickly to easily react to.

#### Dancing Spear (Phase 2)

The main **Balancer''***s'* spear lights up, then swings it across as it glides towards its target and performs a flurry of attacks. The main **Balancer** will then float in the sky, performing multiple slashes that create crescent-shaped projectiles that damages anyone it touches. For the first part of the sequence, players can surge sprint away from the Balancer and escape the range of the slashes. Then, when the **Balancer** soars and sends three projectiles in the players' direction, they can dodge roll towards the projectile (or the **Balancer**) to evade the attacks.

#### Smite (Phase 2)

The main **Balancer''***s **left hand will glow, signaling the other** Balancers'* to simultaneously dive at a player's location. As the **Balancers** dive, they will leave explosive trails that damage players, identical to the trails in the **Purging Dive**. The main **Balancer** will then use a **Purity of Lightning** as the trails explode. To avoid the attack, players can move away from the main **Balancer** as it calls on the others, as players will be able to see where the **Balancers** will dive, allowing them to time a dodge roll properly.

#### Purifying Blast (Phase 2)

The main **Balancer** floats out of the arena, then a single ray of light shows up. After a short delay, an explosion will occur, and the main **Balancer** will appear in the middle of the blast. Players can avoid the explosion by sprinting away from the ray as soon as it appears, or by dodge rolling through the blast to be able to retaliate against the **Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia**.

#### Absolution (Phase 2)

The main **Balancer** teleports all other **Balancers** to its location, then gets down on one knee while holding its spear up, then releases waves of Spears out of the ground, expanding outward. The spears erupt from the ground after around a second, and three more waves appear, each spawning further away than the last. Players can dodge the wave by anticipating and timing a dodge roll towards the **Balancer**, allowing them to counterattack for the rest of the attack sequence. Do not dodge backwards, as this could put you inside one of the spear waves.  
The main **Balancer** casts a spell during this attack that increases the attack power of all **Balancers.** They can get up to 3 stacks of the buff depending on how many Balancers are currently alive (more alive = stronger buff).

#### Pouncing Combo (Phase 2)

The main **Balancer** summons a **Purifying Light** on the ground, backs up while it floats in the sky, then pounces directly at the player. The **Balancer** will then follow up with a flurry of thrusts, with a diving attack as the finisher. Players can dodge the initial **Purifying Light** by rolling sideways, then sprinting away from the main **Balancer** to be able to dodge the pounce more easily. Then, players should keep a safe distance away from the **Balancer** until it performs the final attack.

#### Pulverizing Slams (Phase 2)

The main **Balancer** imbues its spear with magic, slams it onto the ground repeatedly, then slashes upward as it turns around. It will then slam its spear one final time, then pull it out of the ground, creating a fissure around it that damages players. Players can attempt to dodge this attack by dodge rolling the initial hit, then staying behind the **Balancer**. As the main **Balancer** pulverizes the ground, players can counterattack until they have to dodge roll the upward slash and the final sequence.

### Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia Everdark Sovereign Fight Strategy

#### Everdark Sovereign Harmonia Fight Overview

The [Everdark Sovereign](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Everdark_Sovereign "Everdark Sovereign") variant of **Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia** begins similarly to the base version of the encounter. During the first phase, players must defeat all seven [Balancers](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Balancers "Balancers") to progress. Everdark Harmonia will use basic spear attacks and occasionally cast spells, such as the **Circle of Purification**. The **Everdark Balancers** encountered here will have relatively low health and can be easily staggered or interrupted, allowing players to defeat each one quickly. Players should position themselves in a way to lure out and eliminate the Balancers one at a time, minimizing the risk of being overwhelmed by multiple enemies at once.

After all seven Balancers are defeated, the encounter will transition into the second phase. The Balancers resurrect simultaneously, bearing a more grotesque appearance, with visibly disfigured flesh hanging from their bodies. At the start of this phase, a single **Everdark Balancer** will emit a loud shriek and immediately charge toward a player, initiating an assault. Shortly after the first **Everdark Balancer** charges, the remaining **Balancers** activate in succession, each shrieking before engaging. In this phase, the **Everdark Balancers** will use more aggressive attacks, such as rapid flurries of spear strikes and long-reaching charging thrusts.

Unlike the base variant of the Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia encounter, the second phase of the **Everdark Sovereign** fight will not feature a head Balancer with additional attacks or a distinct appearance. Instead, all **Everdark Balancers** share similar health values, comparable ot those in the first phase, allowing them to be defeated in a few hits. Despite their low health, their increased aggression and stronger attacks require players to be more defensive, carefully avoiding incoming attacks before committing to retaliate.

After defeating all **Everdark Balancers' *in the second phase, the fight enters its final stage.*** *Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia **will transform into a massive leviathan-like beast, performing attacks inspired by aquatic movement. In this form,** Everdark Harmonia **can dive into the ground, creating shockwaves that ripple across the battlefield, and briefly burrow before resurfacing to unleash barrages of spears raining down from above. During this stage, players will still have to fight the** Everdark Balancers **from the second phase as the leviathan disappears, which becomes more difficult due to the onslaught of the leviathan. The combined pressure from the leviathan's AoE attacks and the** Everdark Balancers''*aggressive behavior makes the final phase significantly more difficult than the first two phases.

#### Phase 1

At the start of the boss encounter with the **Everdark Balancers**, players will have to face the seven [Balancers](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Balancers "Balancers"), identical to the first phase of the standard Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia fight. Each Balancer wields a spear and uses basic thrusting and lunging attacks, which are heavily telegraphed. Compared to the later phases of the fight, the first phase will be easy, giving players large windows to fight back and stagger the seven **Balancers**.

Players can safely bait attacks, lure out a single **Balancer** at a time, then overwhelm them if playing in a party. Focusing on one **Balancer** at a time is the most reliable approach, allowing players to steadily reduce their numbers. Positioning is still important in this phase, as multiple **Balancers** can quickly surround careless players and chain their attacks to deal devastating damage and waste the players' resources.

#### Phase 2

Once all seven **Balancers** are defeated, the fight will abruptly shift. One of the **Balancers** lying down will tear its face apart, triggering a transformation that stains the arena and covers up the screen to change the environment. The **Everdark Balancers** will re-emerge as bloodlusted and disfigured, gaining access to more aggressive attacks.

At the beginning of this phase, a single **Balancer** will let out a shriek before charging at a player in frenzy. Almost immediately afterward, the remaining six **Balancers** will also shriek and rush in. Players should prioritize eliminating the first charging **Balancer** as quickly as possible to not only reduce their numbers, but to also stagger the remaining **Balancers** to make them vulnerable to attacks. These disfigured [Balancers](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Balancers "Balancers") will have relatively low health, making it possible for players to quickly reduce their numbers before they completely overwhelm the players.

Despite their low health, the **Everdark Balancers** are dangerous when they are clumped up in a group due to their deadlier attacks. Their new attacks include fast spear rushes and **Impaling Assaults** that can be difficult to avoid if a Balancer moves off-screen. Players should maintain awareness of the enemies' positions, as being caught between multiple **Balancers** can quickly lead to heavy damage or even death. One key mechanic in this phase is that defeating a**n Everdark Balancer** briefly staggers the remaining ones, creating a short window to attack. Players are strongly encouraged to focus their attacks on a single [Balancer](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Balancers "Balancers") to slowly reduce their numbers.

The **Everdark Balancers** may also gain a temporary damage buff after successfully connecting their attack to a player. While the buff is applied to them, they will gradually lose health over time, although it will be insignificant. Players should not rely on the DoT, and should instead prioritize playing defensively until a safe opportunity to retaliate arises.

#### Phase 3

After six of the **Everdark Balancers** are defeated, the final [Balancer](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Balancers "Balancers") transforms into a leviathan-like creature that wields the Balancers' spear. After transforming, it will immediately leap into the air and crash down, sending shockwaves outward from the point of impact. Players should sprint away as soon as the transformation begins to have enough space to time a dodge roll or jump over the shockwaves.

During this phase, the leviathan **Everdark Harmonia** will incorporate the final portion of the **Harmonious Smite** attack, causing barrages of spears to rain down in a straight line. Players can safely avoid this attack by positioning themselves within the first wave of spear impacts, as the spears will not strike in the same area. This creates brief openings to either attack sparingly or reset as the boss finishes the sequence. Most of the leviathan's attacks will zone players away, and its high mobility allows it to disengage or dodge the players' attacks.

The phase ends with the leviathan's signature attack, **Blood Bloom**. The leviathan will stand still as its head opens like a blooming flower, then begin channeling a spell that causes blood to erupt from its body, rapidly inflicting [![hemorrhage status effect elden ring wiki guide 25px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/0/00/Hemorrhage_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png/20px-Hemorrhage_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Blood_Loss "Blood Loss") [Blood Loss](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Blood_Loss "Blood Loss") buildup on all players. Once the attack sequence finishes, the leviathan will disappear, and the fight resets to the second phase, wherein players will have to fight the seven **Everdark Balancers**. This cycle will repeat until **Everdark Harmonia** is defeated.

During **Blood Bloom**, all players should immediately focus their attacks on the leviathan to attempt to stagger it. Successfully interrupting the spell will cancel the attack entirely, allowing players to avoid the attack and to also cycle back to the **Second Phase**.

### Weapon Bequeathed Harmonia Everdark Sovereign Attacks & Counters

#### Circle of Purification

A **Weapon-Bequeathed Harmonia** assumes a lowered stance, channeling a spell that makes spears emerge in a circle around it. As soon asthe spell is channeled, players can sprint out of the circle or time a dodge roll towards the boss as the spears emerge to retaliate as it recovers.

#### Spear Swipe

A **Weapon-Bequeathed Harmonia** teleports, then leaps in the direction of a player, swiping its spear across as it lands. When a **Balancer** leaps at the player, they can dodge roll towards the boss to avoid the swipe. Players may then retaliate by attacking once or twice, depending on their attack speed.

#### Spear Thrust

A **Balancer** holds its spear blade-first, runs at its target, then thrusts its spear forward. Occasionally, a **Balancer** will do two consecutive **Spear Thrusts**. When a **Balancer** holds its spear horizontally, facing forward, players can strafe sideways or dodge roll to the side to avoid the Spear. Players may then circle towards the back of the **Weapon-Bequeathed Harmonia** to punish it as it recovers from the attack.

#### Double Spear Swipe

One of the **Balancers** will wind up its spear on the right, then swipe it across twice. Players can dodge roll towards the **Balancer** to get to its rear to avoid the second swipe and retaliate, or dodge roll away to get out of melee distance.

#### Purity of Lightning (Phase 2)

An **Everdark** **Balancer** raises its left hand as it floats in the air, emitting light, then dives at the player using its lightning-imbued hand. If the **Purity of Lightning** catches players, they will be impaled with a large spear that emerges from the ground, then stabbed by a **Balancer**, dealing devastating damage. When the **Balancer** starts to dive at the player, they can dodge roll towards the Balancer to get to its rear and attack it from behind. The **Lightning Dive** can reach players from a significant distance, so players should be cautious even if they maintain a safe distance from the **Balancers**.

#### Rabid Slashes (Phase 2)

An **Everdark Balancer** lifts its spear, then performs multiple slashes as it moves forward. For this attack, players should distance themselves from the aggressive **Balancer** by dodge rolling away during the attack and maintaining their distance, as the attack will be hard to predict if they stick to the **Balancer**. Dodging should be the priority, as it can be difficult to retaliate in between attacks.

#### Leaping Dive (Phase 3)

The leviathan **Balancer** leaps high in the air, then dives toward the ground, creating a shockwave that travels outward. When the leviathan **Balancer** leaps, players should spring away from it, making it easier to dodge the shockwave by dodge rolling or jumping towards the shockwave as it passes towards the player.

#### Spear Barrage (Phase 3)

The leviathan **Balancer** holds its spear up as it glows, channeling a barrage of spears to rain down on the sky, traveling in a straight line where it faces. There will then be more barrages of spears that will travel parallel to the initial wave. Players can avoid the attack by dodge rolling towards the first barrage of spears as it passes to avoid the following waves.

#### Purification Waves (Phase 3)

The **Everdark Balancer** burrows for a short time, emerges, then swipes its spear multiple times, emitting waves of light that travel in front of it that damage players hit by the projectile. Players can dodge the attack by timing the dodge rolls as they hit, jumping above the light waves, or by strafing to the sides if they are far from the leviathan.

#### Blood Bloom (Phase 3)

The **Everdark Balancer** stands still with the top of its head wide open. Its head will then cause blood around it to explode, inflicting [![hemorrhage status effect elden ring wiki guide 25px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/0/00/Hemorrhage_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png/20px-Hemorrhage_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Blood_Loss "Blood Loss") [Blood Loss](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Blood_Loss "Blood Loss") and damaging nearby players. After **Blood Bloom**, the leviathan will transform back to the seven bloodlusted **Everdark Balancers**. When players see the **Everdark Balancer** channeling the Blood Bloom attack, they have to try to stagger the boss by attacking it, cancelling the whole **Blood Bloom** sequence.

#### Slithering Attack (Phase 3)

The leviathan **Everdark Balancer** quicklyslithers around the battlefield, damaging players colliding with its body. At the end of the attack, the leviathan **Balancer** will then burrow again, damaging players near it. As soon as the Everdark Balancer moves around the battlefield, players are recommended to move away from it and dodge roll away if it will collide with the player. The boss can be hard to chase during this attack, so players should look to avoid the attack instead of looking for an opening to retaliate.

#### Impaling Assault (Phase 3)

An **Everdark Balancer** jumps up as its spear glows, then dives toward the ground as it slams its spear. It will then repeat the sequence two more times, with the third one being delayed. Players hit with the attack will be inflicted with [![hemorrhage status effect elden ring wiki guide 25px](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenringnightreign/thumb/0/00/Hemorrhage_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png/20px-Hemorrhage_status_effect_elden_ring_wiki_guide_25px.png)](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Blood_Loss "Blood Loss") [Blood Loss](https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Blood_Loss "Blood Loss") buildup. Players can time their dodge rolls as the boss slams the ground, allowing them to counterattack after the third slam.

## Key insights into the Brazil University Rankings 2026

- Brazil is among the world’s fastest-growing major economies, with economic reforms that are constantly pushing it forward on the international stage.
- There are 68 universities from Brazil in the [Latin America University Rankings 2026](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2026/latin-america-university-rankings). It is the most-represented country in the ranking

## Choosing a university in Brazil

Brazil is South America’s fastest-growing economy and this is reflected in the many university options in the bustling cities of Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, among others. Public university education is free for international and domestic students, so students will most likely only have to pay a registration fee. Private universities do charge fees and this will depend on the course and university.

The table for the best universities in Brazil was derived from data collected from the *THE* Latin America University Rankings. The results are calculated using 18 performance indicators underlying five metrics: research environment, teaching (the learning environment), research quality, industry and international outlook. # THE - Times Higher Education World University Rankings - Rankings

THE (Times Higher Education) é uma empresa que desde 2004, avalia e fornece dados confiáveis de desempenho universitário no cenário global e fornece recursos aos interessados para compreender as diferentes missões e sucesso das instituições de ensino superior.

![](https://www.prdu.unicamp.br/wp-content/uploads/sites/22/2023/08/times-higher-education-1-300x102.png "Times Higher Education")

| **Publicação** | **2021** | **2022** | **2023** | **2024** | **2026** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| *THE Latin America University Rankings* | 3 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 |

#### RESULTADO THE WORLD UNIVERSITY RANKINGS – INDICADORES

| **PUBLICAÇÃO** | **2024** | **2025** | **2026** | **2027** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **#UNICAMP** | **351 – 400** | **351 – 400** | **351 – 400** | **326 – 350** |
| Nº Instituições participantes | **1.907** | **2.092** | **2.191** | **2.297** |
| Overall | 49,1-51,0 | 49,4-51,0 | 49,9-51,5 | 52,3-53,3 |
| Teaching | 50,0 | 48,8 | 51,7 | 56,0 |
| Research Environment | 45,5 | 47,2 | 48,0 | 53,3 |
| Research Quality | 54,0 | 51,0 | 50,2 | 49,7 |
| Industry | 65,5 | 76,7 | 78,1 | 82,7 |
| International Outlook | 40,4 | 40,6 | 41,5 | 41,6 |

#### Metodologia

A metodologia cuidadosamente balanceada e abrangente foi desenvolvida com base em 13 indicadores de desempenho separados, abrangendo toda a gama de áreas de atividade essenciais de uma universidade de primeira linha: ensino, pesquisa, transferência de conhecimento e perspectivas internacionais.

- **Criteria** **Indicador** **Weigth**
- Teaching Reputation Survey 15%
- Staff-to-student ratio 4.5%
- Doctorate-to-bachelor´s ratio 2.25%
- Doctorates-awarded-to-academic-staff ratio 6%
- Institutional Income 2.25%
- Research Reputation Survey 18%
- Research Income 6%
- Research productivity 6%
- Citations Citations 30%
- International Outlook Proportion of International Students 2.5%
- Proportion of International Staff 2.5%
- International Colaboration 2.5%
- Industry Income Industry Income 2.5%
- **Total** **100%**

A abordagem de padronização que usamos baseia-se na distribuição de dados dentro de um determinado indicador, onde calculamos uma função de probabilidade acumulada e avaliamos onde o indicador de uma determinada instituição fica dentro dessa função.

Para todos os indicadores, exceto para o levantamento de *Academic Reputation*, calculamos a função de probabilidade acumulada usando uma versão do Z-*scoring*. A distribuição dos dados no levantamento de exige que adicionemos um componente exponencial.

#### *Subjects*

O *Ranking THE* permite a classificação por assunto para auxiliar os estudantes no processo de escolha da universidade, conforme mostrado abaixo:

| **Subject** | **Unidades de Ensino e Pesquisa** |
| --- | --- |
| Arts & Humanities | IA / IEL / CEL (docentes) |
| Clinical, Pre-clinical & Health | FCF / FCM / FEnF / FOP |
| Engineering & Technology | FEA / FEAGRI / FEC / FEEC / FEM / FEQ / FT |
| Computer Science | IC |
| Life Sciences | FEF / IB |
| Physical Sciences | IFGW / IG / IMECC / IQ |
| Social Sciences | IFCH |
| Business and Economics | FCA / IE |
| Education | FE |

#### Informações Relevantes

# Rankings of universities in Brazil

For broader coverage of this topic, see [Universities and Higher Education in Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universities_and_Higher_Education_in_Brazil "Universities and Higher Education in Brazil").

Universities in [Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazil "Brazil") are ranked in a number of ways, including both national and international ranks.

## National Rankings

### Ranking Universitário Folha

Since 2012, Brazil's largest newspaper [Folha de S. Paulo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Folha_de_S._Paulo "Folha de S. Paulo") has organized a national ranking of universities[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rankings_of_universities_in_Brazil#cite_note-RUF-1) with criteria akin to those used by better known worldwide rankings: research, teaching, internationalization, innovation and market value.

### Brazilian government evaluation

Higher education evaluations are also conducted by the Brazilian Government; specifically by **Inep** (Instituto Nacional de Estudos e
Pesquisas Educacionais; English: National Institute of Studies and Research). The Government uses a **General Index of Courses** (Portuguese: [Índice Geral de Cursos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Índice_Geral_de_Cursos?action=edit&redlink=1 "Índice Geral de Cursos (page does not exist)") [[pt](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Índice%20Geral%20de%20Cursos "pt:Índice Geral de Cursos")]; **IGC**) to determine the quality of Brazilian's higher education (graduate and post-graduate courses) in [Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazil "Brazil"). [Universidade de São Paulo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universidade_de_São_Paulo "Universidade de São Paulo"), one of the most prestigious universities in the country, has been participating in the **IGC** since 2013 as part of a technical cooperation with **Inep** that will last three years, during which time the results concerning the university's courses will not be disclosed. Only then will the university decide whether to fully participate in the government evaluation.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rankings_of_universities_in_Brazil#cite_note-RUF-1)

pergunta: Você pode listar todos os secretários de Comércio dos EUA do início de 2018 até o fim de 2024, incluindo secretários interinos?
resposta:
Com base na pesquisa realizada, aqui está a lista completa dos Secretários de Comércio dos Estados Unidos do início de 2018 até o fim de 2024, incluindo os secretários interinos:

### Período de 2017 a 2021 (Governo Trump)

*   **Wilbur Ross** (Titular):
    *   **Entrou no cargo:** 28 de fevereiro de 2017.
    *   **Deixou o cargo:** 20 de janeiro de 2021 (aposentou-se).
    *   *Nota:* Embora tenha assumido em 2017, foi o secretário durante todo o período inicial de 2018 e grande parte de 2019, 2020 e início de 2021.

*   **Karen Dunn Kelley** (Interino):
    *   **Período:** 20 de janeiro de 2021 a 20 de janeiro de 2021.
    *   *Detalhes:* Assumiu o cargo apenas por cerca de duas horas no dia da transição de poder, após a aposentadoria de Wilbur Ross, antes de ser substituída por Wynn Coggins.

### Período de 2021 a 2025 (Governo Biden)

*   **Wynn Coggins** (Interino):
    *   **Período:** 20 de janeiro de 2021 a 3 de março de 2021.
    *   *Detalhes:* Substituiu Karen Dunn Kelley no mesmo dia da transição de poder, assumindo o cargo formalmente como interina até que Gina Raimondo fosse confirmada pelo Senado.

*   **Gina Raimondo** (Titular):
    *   **Entrou no cargo:** 3 de março de 2021.
    *   **Deixou o cargo:** 20 de janeiro de 2025.
    *   *Atuação:* Foi a única secretária titular durante todo o mandato presidencial de Joe Biden (2021-2024), servindo desde o final do ano de 2020 até o início de 2025.

### Resumo Cronológico para o Período Solicitado (Jan 2018 - Dez 2024):

1.  **2018 - Janeiro de 2021:** Wilbur Ross
2.  **20 de Jan de 2021 - 20 de Jan de 2021:** Karen Dunn Kelley (Interino)
3.  **20 de Jan de 2021 - 3 de Mar de 2021:** Wynn Coggins (Interino)
4.  **3 de Mar de 2021 - Janeiro de 2025:** Gina Raimondo

Portanto, no intervalo especificado de **início de 2018 até o fim de 2024**, houve três pessoas exercendo a função: **Wilbur Ross**, **Karen Dunn Kelley** e **Gina Raimondo**. O último interino mencionado, Don Graves, assumiu o cargo apenas em **20 de janeiro de 2025**, logo após o fim do mandato de Gina Raimondo, portanto não se enquadra estritamente no período solicitado.

The **United States secretary of commerce** (**SecCom**) is the head of the [United States Department of Commerce](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Department_of_Commerce "United States Department of Commerce"). The secretary serves as the principal advisor to the [president of the United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_the_United_States "President of the United States") on all matters relating to [commerce](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commerce "Commerce"). The secretary reports directly to the president and is a statutory member of the [Cabinet of the United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabinet_of_the_United_States "Cabinet of the United States"). The secretary is [appointed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prerogative "Prerogative") by the president, with the [advice and consent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advice_and_Consent_Clause "Advice and Consent Clause") of the [United States Senate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Senate "United States Senate"). The secretary of commerce is responsible for promoting American businesses and industries. The department states its mission as 'to foster, promote, and develop the foreign and domestic commerce of the United States'.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Commerce#cite_note-2)

Until 1913, there was one [secretary of commerce and labor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Department_of_Commerce_and_Labor "United States Department of Commerce and Labor"), uniting this department with the [United States Department of Labor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Department_of_Labor "United States Department of Labor"), which is now headed by a separate [United States secretary of labor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Labor "United States Secretary of Labor").[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Commerce#cite_note-3)

The secretary of commerce is a [Level I position in the Executive Schedule](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Executive_Schedule#Level_I "Executive Schedule")[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Commerce#cite_note-4) with an annual salary of [US$](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/US_Dollar "US Dollar") 250,600, as of January 2025.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Commerce#cite_note-Salary-5)

The current secretary of commerce is [Howard Lutnick](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Howard_Lutnick "Howard Lutnick").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Commerce#cite_note-6)

## Line of succession

The line of succession for the secretary of commerce is as follows:[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Commerce#cite_note-13)

1. [Deputy Secretary of Commerce](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deputy_Secretary_of_Commerce "Deputy Secretary of Commerce")
2. General Counsel of the Department of Commerce
3. [Under Secretary of Commerce for International Trade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Under_Secretary_of_Commerce_for_International_Trade "Under Secretary of Commerce for International Trade")
4. [Under Secretary of Commerce for Economic Affairs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Under_Secretary_of_Commerce_for_Economic_Affairs "Under Secretary of Commerce for Economic Affairs")
5. [Under Secretary of Commerce for Standards and Technology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Under_Secretary_of_Commerce_for_Standards_and_Technology "Under Secretary of Commerce for Standards and Technology")
6. [Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Under_Secretary_of_Commerce_for_Oceans_and_Atmosphere "Under Secretary of Commerce for Oceans and Atmosphere") and Administrator of the [National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Oceanic_and_Atmospheric_Administration "National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration")
7. Under Secretary of Commerce for Export Administration
8. Chief Financial Officer of the Department of Commerce and Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Administration
9. Boulder Laboratories Site Manager, [National Institute of Standards and Technology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Institute_of_Standards_and_Technology "National Institute of Standards and Technology")
